title: The Queen Checks and Collects
setup: Black has a rook, bishop and knight for your queen, and the knight on h4 has wandered to the edge with no defender.
hint: Find a queen check that also attacks the knight.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qa4+}} checks the king on e8 along the diagonal and attacks the knight on h4 along the fourth rank. Black has to answer the check, and no answer, whether {{Bd7}}, {{c6}}, {{b5}} or a king move, also guards the knight. Next move, {{Qxh4}} takes it, and the material swings your way.

A queen fork is a check on one line and a loose piece on another.
